captions_note: the card carries those words: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while the iris and card are up (work/reel_captions.json)
in_a_reel: LINE is one short line the speaker says, up to about 8 words; start the slot about 0.7 s before its first word (the close may sit on the end of the line before, across a cut) and end it about 0.3 s after its last word
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's look before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit LINE and BIG in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # measures the head, prints the times and the snapshot list
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
